contradictions.evidence_a_claim: Posh Casey 201% ROI, 89% FCR — strong GenAI IVR performance
contradictions.evidence_b_claim: HVCU Rewards! platform reliability issues — technology failure signal
contradictions.justification: E-060 applies to P2C4.7.1 (loyalty rewards), not P2C3.3.7 (GenAI IVR). Contradiction was apparent, not real — different subcapabilities.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Evidence scope separation: E-045 covers contact center GenAI; E-060 covers loyalty platform — not same subcap. No contradiction after scope clarification.

contradictions.evidence_a_claim: MuleSoft Cloud confirmed in HVCU SaaS stack — professional iPaaS in production
contradictions.evidence_b_claim: LeadIQ tech stack = 8 basic tools only — limited technology sophistication signal
contradictions.justification: LeadIQ tech stack scanners detect website-embedded tools, not SaaS back-office platforms. MuleSoft Cloud is back-office middleware — invisible to surface web scans. E-085 (Cloud Services Admin job posting explicitly naming MuleSoft) is the authoritative source.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Tier hierarchy: E-085 is job-posting-confirmed (T2 structured signal); E-067 is LeadIQ surface scan (T3 limited-depth). T2 > T3 in resolution. MuleSoft is SaaS (not detected by web-stack scanners).

contradictions.evidence_a_claim: Illuma Shield voice biometric deployed — fraud/ATO prevention capability confirmed
contradictions.evidence_b_claim: BSA program active but AML transaction monitoring platform vendor unconfirmed
contradictions.justification: No contradiction — different dimensions of fraud risk. Illuma = identity/ATO layer; AML = transaction monitoring layer. ISS-005 applied to AML subcap; biometric subcaps not capped.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Scope separation: E-051 covers ATO prevention (biometric), E-076 covers AML/BSA transaction monitoring — different subcap dimensions within P3C2. ISS-005 MATERIAL cap applied to AML subcap (P3C2.3.1) while biometric subcaps score without cap.

contradictions.evidence_a_claim: CAIO Kausar mandate: data-ready strategies — data governance building signal
contradictions.evidence_b_claim: Data Engineering Manager + Senior DE hiring — data team building, not yet built
contradictions.justification: CAIO hiring (E-082) and DE hiring (E-089) are both forward-looking build signals. Neither confirms deployed data governance capability. Score correctly set at M1.88 (building phase, not deployed).
contradictions.resolution_rule: Both signals are consistent but point to BUILD PHASE, not deployed capability. Score reflects current state (M1.88), not future target. No contradiction — both sources confirm data governance is in construction.
